decisions.reason: The compact trommel screen is a renamed, upgraded version of the well-received BASIC 518, so it builds directly on the firm's core screening know-how and on market feedback it can already interpret.
Mobile high-speed flail shredders are close to the firm's established mobile shredding expertise, and the line has a dedicated page, so its own R&D can assimilate early results and refine the models.
The mobile high-speed grinder line extends the firm's mobile comminution knowledge, although it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests somewhat less commitment.

The stationary electric fine shredder lies slightly further from the mobile core and is only mentioned, but it still draws on the firm's shredding and plant-building knowledge and its electrification development.
The green-waste grinder serves the firm's core composting and biomass customers with related technology, so management can learn from early results despite its low visibility.
Single-shaft pre-shredders build on the firm's long pre-shredding experience, have their own page, and fit the strategy of handling tougher processing requirements.
